spectral_library.name: Anorthosite (Lunar Highlands Endmember)
spectral_library.diagnostic_features: Broad Fe2+ substitution absorption band centered around 1.25 um, rising slope toward SWIR

spectral_library.name: Tholeiitic Basalt (Lunar Mare / Martian Plains)
spectral_library.diagnostic_features: Characteristic dual Fe2+ pyroxene absorption minima near 1.05 um and 2.05 um

spectral_library.name: Nontronite Clay (Smectite / Jezero Delta)
spectral_library.diagnostic_features: Strong metal-OH overtone at 1.41 um, H2O bend/stretch combination at 1.91 um, diagnostic Fe-OH doublet near 2.29-2.35 um

spectral_library.name: Gypsum (Hydrated Sulfate)
spectral_library.diagnostic_features: Sharp, deep H2O vibrational absorptions at 1.45 um and 1.94 um, strong drop-off at 2.22 um

spectral_library.name: Water Ice (Cryogenic Crystalline)
spectral_library.diagnostic_features: Extreme absorption troughs at 1.50 um and 2.02 um; high VIS albedo rapidly crashing into zero NIR/SWIR reflectance

spectral_library.name: Hematite (Ferric Iron Oxide)
spectral_library.diagnostic_features: Steep ferric absorption edge from UV to 0.55 um, crystal field 6A1 -> 4T1G absorption minimum at 0.86 um
